grading.subpage_coverage: ONLY the RIGHT subpage (p.103) is graded. The left subpage (p.102) carries exactly ONE figure, where the grouping metric itself reports association as POSSIBLE-but-not-discriminated — it cannot add evidence to the claim this fixture exists for, so it was not authored rather than authored and quietly discounted. A subpage absent from this file is skipped by the eval.

No in-photo figure numbers, so only the geometry arm is under test. The two pairs in caption_figure_pairs are the load-bearing assertion.
